purpose: Planning evidence and future GIS importer regression fixture inventory; no app implementation
xy_path_digest_specification: SHA-256 of binary stream starting with ASCII pipeline-xy-paths-v1 followed by NUL. For each SHP record in physical order, append ASCII R, big-endian uint64 zero-based record index, uint32 shape type, uint32 part count. For each part append ASCII P, uint32 zero-based part index, uint64 vertex count, then each XY coordinate as two big-endian IEEE-754 float64 values in source order, then ASCII e. End each record with ASCII E. Null records have zero parts and are included. Z/M and DBF values are excluded. The explicit record/part boundaries prevent accidental joining.

samples.null_geometry_identifier_note: Indices are physical SHP/DBF zero-based record positions (pyshp oid), not PLINE_ID or GlobalID values.

dimensions.measurement_policy: Horizontal XY only; Z/M retained in the original archive and summarized without interpreting their units or semantics.

crs.name: NAD83
crs.accuracy_note: 4 m is the coordinate operation's stated accuracy, not the source survey accuracy or a mileage error bound.

independent_reference.method: pyproj.Geod(ellps='GRS80').line_length per actual SHP part; math.fsum across parts; no connection between records/parts
independent_reference.per_record_index_note: List index is the zero-based physical SHP record index; ordinal = index + 1. Each line value is math.fsum of its own part lengths; null geometry is null, not zero.
independent_reference.scope: Independent of application parser/analyzer; geodesic library is pyproj, also used by the application, so not an independent geodesic implementation.

limitations: Only these exact hash-pinned customer archives are accepted; not a general archive validator or production importer.
The XML metadata files are opaque archive bytes. Their contents are not parsed, executed, or treated as instructions.
CRC verifies archive consistency, not correctness or source survey accuracy.
Both samples are NAD83 geographic PolyLineZ; they do not establish GPKG, projected CRS, Point, MultiPoint, Polygon, or mixed-layer support.
EPSG:1188 is explicitly pinned after whole-extent area-of-use containment for these samples only; not a global transformation fallback.
No application import, overlap analysis, state analysis, packaged execution, or automated regression test is run by this inspector.
Identifier summaries expose uniqueness counts, not raw customer attribute values. Source Z/M semantics and accuracy are unknown.
